explanation: The application assumes access follows owner_id (the current owner, post-transfer), but the RLS policy still checks created_by (the original, permanent author) -- a leftover from before the ownership-transfer feature existed. These are NOT equivalent columns: after a note is transferred, the original creator retains database-level read access they should no longer have, while the new owner (per the application's own logic) has no corresponding guarantee at the database level. This is a genuine access-control bug introduced by a feature change, not a cosmetic naming difference.
